    function addMesh(geometry, material, parent = ship, position = null) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      if (position) mesh.position.copy(position);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addBox(w, h, d, material, x, y, z, parent = ship) {
      return addMesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d),
        material,
        parent,
        new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z)
      );
    }

    function addCylinder(
      rTop,
      rBottom,
      height,
      material,
      x,
      y,
      z,
      parent = ship,
      segments = 18
    ) {
      return addMesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rTop, rBottom, height, segments),
        material,
        parent,
        new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z)
      );
    }

    const Y_AXIS = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

    function setRodBetween(mesh, a, b) {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(b, a);
      const length = direction.length();
      mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(Y_AXIS, direction.normalize());
      mesh.scale.set(1, length, 1);
    }

    function addRod(a, b, radius, material, parent = ship, segments = 10) {
      const mesh = addMesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius, 1, segments),
        material,
        parent
      );
      setRodBetween(mesh, a, b);
      return mesh;
    }

    const skyMaterial = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({

          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);

        varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

        void main() {

          float blend = smoothstep(-0.12, 0.72, height);
          vec3 color = mix(horizonColor, topColor, blend);
          gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);

        varying vec3 vNormal;
        varying float vWave;
        varying float vDistance;

        float waveHeight(vec2 p) {
          float h1 = sin(p.x * 0.22 + time * 0.65) * 0.16;
          float h2 = sin(p.y * 0.31 - time * 0.78) * 0.10;
          float h3 = sin((p.x + p.y) * 0.13 + time * 0.42) * 0.06;

          float dx =
            cos(p.x * 0.22 + time * 0.65) * 0.22 * 0.16 * 0.18 +
            cos((p.x + p.y) * 0.13 + time * 0.42) * 0.13 * 0.06 * 0.18;

          float dz =
            cos(p.y * 0.31 - time * 0.78) * 0.31 * 0.10 * -0.18 +
            cos((p.x + p.y) * 0.13 + time * 0.42) * 0.13 * 0.06 * -0.18;

          return h1 + h2 + h3;
        }

        void main() {
          vec3 p = position;
          p.y += waveHeight(p.xz);

          vec3 normal = normalize(vec3(
            -waveHeight(p.xz + vec2(0.1, 0.0)).x + waveHeight(p.xz - vec2(0.1, 0.0)).x,
            1.0,
            -waveHeight(p.xz + vec2(0.0, 0.1)).y + waveHeight(p.xz - vec2(0.0, 0.1)).y
          ));

          vec4 worldPosition = modelMatrix * vec4(p, 1.0);
          vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
          vWave = p.y;
          vDistance = length(position.xz);

          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * worldPosition;
        }
      `,
      fragmentShader: `
        uniform float time;
        uniform vec3 sunDirection;
        varying vec3 vNormal;
        varying float vWave;
        varying float vDistance;

        void main() {
          vec3 normal = normalize(vNormal);
          vec3 viewDirection = normalize(cameraPosition - vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0));

          float fresnel = pow(1.0 - max(dot(normal, viewDirection), 0.0), 3.0);
          vec3 deepColor = vec3(0.012, 0.17, 0.23);
          vec3 shallowColor = vec3(0.055, 0.39, 0.47);

          vec3 color = mix(deepColor, shallowColor, 0.34 + vWave * 0.8);
          color = mix(color, vec3(0.49, 0.67, 0.69), fresnel * 0.58);

          float specular = pow(
            max(dot(reflect(-sunDirection, normal), viewDirection), 0.0),
            120.0
          );

          color += vec3(1.0, 0.82, 0.52) * specular * 2.2;
          color += vec3(0.18, 0.25, 0.24) * exp(-vDistance * 0.075);

          float fogFactor = smoothstep(28.0, 95.0, vDistance);
          color = mix(color, vec3(0.61, 0.73, 0.75), fogFactor);

          gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
        }
      `

        const top = station.top;
        const bottom = station.bottom;

        const ring = [
          [-w, top],
